title.name: Venture capital, fund economics and venture math

overview.description: Fund economics explain investor behaviour better than any conversation with an investor will. A fund that needs a $1B outcome cannot fund a $100M company, however good it is.
objectives: Read a fund’s size, vintage and ownership target and predict what it can say yes to
Model dilution across three rounds without flinching
Understand SAFEs, valuation caps, lead investors, syndicates and board dynamics

steps.intro: Fund economics explain investor behaviour better than any conversation with an investor will. A fund that needs a $1B outcome cannot fund a $100M company, however good it is.
instructions: Build the dilution model: this round, the next, the one after.
For your ten target funds, write fund size, typical cheque and ownership target.
Cut any fund whose model your company cannot satisfy. That list is your strategy memo.

submission.description: Produce the Investor Strategy Memo and log it against this module in Homeroom. Done means the artefact exists, not that you read the page.
